data.name: Ghazaliyah
data.gender_notes: Ghazaliyah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.short_meaning: Traveler of the garden of knowledge
data.long_meaning: A woman who is a traveler in the garden of knowledge, seeking wisdom and enlightenment, inspired by the name of the great scholar Al-Ghazali. The name Ghazaliyah carries the meaning “Traveler of the garden of knowledge” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Ghazaliyah usually hope their child will grow to embody traveler of the garden of knowledge and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name for a woman who is on a spiritual journey, seeking knowledge and enlightenment, and is inspired by the name of the great Islamic scholar Al-Ghazali.
data.etymology: Ghazaliyah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Traveler of the garden of knowledge.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ghazaliyah total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

in_arabic.name: غزالية
in_arabic.meaning: اسم مؤنث يعني الغزال أو الظبية
in_arabic.long_meaning: غزالية هو اسم علم مؤنث عربي، مشتق من كلمة غزال، ويعني الغزال الصغير أو الظبية. الغزال في الثقافة العربية يرمز للسرعة والخفة والجمال. هذا الاسم يحمل صفات جميلة، مما يجعله محبوبًا بين الأسماء العربية. وقد وردت كلمة غزال في القرآن الكريم في سورة الأنعام: «وَلَئِنْ سَأَلْتَهُم مَنْ خَلَقَ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ لَيَقُولُنَّ اللَّهُ» الآية ١٠١، وإن لم يكن الاسم مذكورًا بشكل مباشر، إلا أن الكلمة تحمل معاني طبيعية جميلة متعلقة بالحياة البرية.

in_urdu.name: غزالیہ
in_urdu.meaning: غزال یا ہرن کے معنی میں
in_urdu.long_meaning: غزالیہ ایک مؤنث نام ہے جو عربی زبان سے ماخوذ ہے۔ اس کا مطلب ہے غزال یا ہرن۔ غزال کو عرب ثقافت میں خوبصورتی، سرعة اور چستی کی علامت کے طور پر دیکھا جاتا ہے۔ یہ نام جنوبی ایشیائی مسلمانوں کے درمیان مقبول ہے کیونکہ یہ خوبصورت اور معنی خیز ہے۔ نام کی عربی جڑیں اسے روحانی اور ثقافتی اہمیت بھی دیتی ہیں۔

in_hindi.name: ग़ज़ालीया
in_hindi.meaning: हरिण या गज़ल के अर्थ में
in_hindi.long_meaning: ग़ज़ालीया एक सुंदर और अर्थपूर्ण नाम है जो अरबी भाषा से लिया गया है। इसका अर्थ है हरिण या गज़ल। यह नाम भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में पसंद किया जाता है क्योंकि यह नाम प्रकृति की सुंदरता और गति का प्रतीक है। इस नाम की जड़ें अरबी भाषा में हैं, जो इसे एक धार्मिक और सांस्कृतिक महत्व भी देती हैं।

in_pashto.name: غزالية
in_pashto.meaning: د غزال یا ظبۍ په معنا
in_pashto.long_meaning: غزالية د ښکلی مؤنث نوم دی چی د غزال یا ظبۍ څخه مشتق شوی دی. په پښتني کلتور کي غزال د تیزۍ، چټکۍ او ښکلاۍ نښه ده. دا نوم د پښتنو په منځ کي مشهور دی ځکه چی دا ښکلی او معنی داره دی. دا نوم عربي ريښې لري، هغه ته دا نوم ته روحاني او کلتوري ارزښت هم ورکوي.

in_english.name: Ghazaliyah
in_english.meaning: Means gazelle or doe in Arabic
in_english.long_meaning: Ghazaliyah is a feminine given name derived from the Arabic word for gazelle or doe. In Arabic culture, the gazelle symbolizes beauty, swiftness, and agility. The name has its roots in Arabic etymology, specifically from the word 'ghazal' (غزال), which refers to a type of antelope known for its beauty and grace. While not directly mentioned in the Quran, the concept of gazelle-like creatures is associated with natural beauty and vitality. The name Ghazaliyah carries spiritual significance, reflecting qualities of elegance and quickness. It is popular across various Muslim cultures, including in the Middle East, South Asia, and North Africa, due to its meaningful and melodic nature.

data.cultural_impact: The name "Ghazaliyah" personifies a woman who is profoundly devoted to learning and is on a continuous journey towards knowledge and wisdom, inspired by the legacy of Al-Ghazali, a celebrated Islamic scholar who lived during the Middle Ages. Al-Ghazali's reforms and teachings led to a revival of Islamic scholarship and influenced intellectual, social, and spiritual developments in the Muslim world. The name "Ghazaliyah" pays homage to this great scholar and evokes the courage and determination that is often associated with the pursuit of knowledge.
data.spiritual_significance: The name "Ghazaliyah" embodies the spirit of a seeker of truth and knowledge, tapping into the deeply ingrained values of intellectual curiosity and spiritual development that are central to Islamic beliefs. It signifies an unwavering commitment to personal growth and the pursuit of wisdom, as well as a steadfast belief in the power of knowledge to transform one's self and the world around them. "Ghazaliyah" resonates with the belief that knowledge is a sacred gift from God and that the pursuit of knowledge is an essential component of a meaningful and spiritual life.
